prompt: The evaluation repository asks the agent to "Apply fine tuning expertise to this task". The fixture contains a plausible happy path, an adjacent-skill decoy, one invalid or partial state, and a recovery condition that must be demonstrated rather than assumed. The acceptance boundary is fine-tuning-training: establish a measured base-model failure, choose among training/retrieval/prompting/tools/product logic, audit authorization and label leakage, freeze independent train/validation/decision-holdout manifests, and keep checkpoint selection separate from the final comparison. The adjacent computer-vision discipline is a routing decoy unless its separate responsibility is actually requested. Resolve current provider/runtime eligibility and source facts, preserve existing contracts and user-owned state, and produce reproducible success plus failure or recovery evidence. A happy path alone is insufficient; simulated training or evaluator fixtures must remain labeled as such.

training corpus with source/customer IDs, near-duplicates, PII/licensing violations, protected labels/teacher outputs and overlength examples
separate baseline, train, validation and immutable final-holdout manifests with group/time split and contamination audit
pilot/checkpoint metrics plus fixed-boundary base-versus-adapted slices, serving latency/cost and rollback fixtures
representative negative, interruption, compatibility, or recovery path

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual fine-tuning-training boundary and relevant environment before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (broader=implementation; near-neighbor=computer-vision), and not absorb the near-neighbor responsibility merely because it is adjacent.
Start from a measured base-model failure and decide whether training, retrieval, prompting, tools, or product logic is the right intervention.

The result must make its consequential assumptions, ownership, and decision sequence explicit and reproducible, including the promotion contract and labels for unavailable, stale, inferred, simulated, or unresolved evidence.

Compare against the untouched base model on the same untouched holdout with the same prompt/context/tools/decoding/retry boundary and safety slices, inspect overfitting and catastrophic regressions, measure serving cost/latency, prove fresh-process artifact reload and rollback, and preserve exact data/model/config/label provenance for reproducibility.

The result must not take the tempting shortcut prohibited by this skill: Do not train on evaluation answers, leak labels/references/reward outputs/teacher prompts into inputs or graders, split correlated entities across boundaries, assume more epochs improve behavior, use private/licensed data without authority, or claim general capability gains from a narrow training distribution.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (Provider/runtime/base-model/tokenizer eligibility and lifecycle identity; authorized, deduplicated and label-leakage-safe train/validation/test provenance; objective/hyperparameter/checkpoint/seed/runtime identity plus training and validation evidence; untouched base-versus-adapted target/regression/safety evaluation under a fixed boundary; fresh-process reload, serving and rollback evidence), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
